Which of these statements about lightning is TRUE?
options: You are safe from lightning if you stand under a tree.
If your hair starts standing up, lightning is about to strike nearby.
Rubber-soled shoes protect you from getting struck by lightning.
Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
questions.answer: If your hair starts standing up, lightning is about to strike nearby.

questions.question: Which **European landmark** was damaged by extreme weather in recent years?
options: The Eiffel Tower was struck by a tornado.
Flooding nearly collapsed the Leaning Tower of Pisa.
Venice's St. Mark’s Square was submerged in record-breaking high tides.
A storm cracked the glass pyramid at the Louvre.
questions.answer: Venice's St. Mark’s Square was submerged in record-breaking high tides.
